title: Missing and Repeated Grid Values
summary: A square grid should contain every value from 1 through n² once; return [repeated, missing].
statement: For an n × n grid, the intended values are 1 through n². Exactly one value occurs twice and exactly one value is absent. Return the repeated value first and the missing value second.
constraints: Cells contain values from 1 through n², with exactly one repeated and one missing value.
reference_solution:
def missing_repeated_grid_values(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    limit = len(grid) ** 2
    repeated = next(value for value, count in counts.items() if count == 2)
    missing = next(value for value in range(1, limit + 1) if counts[value] == 0)
    return [repeated, missing]
